verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents syncs to 300+ destinations. Each sync connects one model to one destination object and defines how rows map into it, with field mapping set in the app or via the API, so the catalog and per-destination mapping are first-party. However, collected events are stored in the warehouse and then synced through models, not routed directly to destinations. Per-destination filtering is only implied through SQL models and audience filters. Missing for 10: documented direct event forwarding to destinations, explicit per-destination event filtering controls, independent hands-on corroboration of catalog depth for event data.
